entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I hope you can help. I need to return an order. It's a bike helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF0987-6543. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for it, and... well, it's just not right. I really needed that money for something else that came up.
I understand. Let me pull that up. I see the Trail Helmet ordered on December 22nd. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference, I guess. The color just isn't what I expected from the website pictures. It's a shame because I've always been so happy with VeloFit gear. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I'm sorry to hear the color wasn't what you envisioned. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.
Okay... I just really hope this can be sorted out.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your order, and you are well within our 90-day return window. Since the box is unopened, we can definitely process a full refund for you. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful news! Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried. That's a huge weight off my shoulders.

You're very welcome. I'm glad we could resolve this. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original shipping box, and drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days.
I see the email. This is perfect. Thank you again for being so understanding.
Of course. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
